author: Yffe
content:
FIXED. Root cause: thermite_tv::exec_stmt_encode::thread_stmt's Stmt::If arm unconditionally returned RefEncodeError::Unsupported, so the GROUNDED AC-4 if-statement-mutation body { let mut r = x; if x < 10 { r = r + 1; } else { r = r + 2; } r } could not be encoded by body_ref_state / body_equivalence_obligation, despite .design/verified/exec-stmt-tv.md REQ-1 listing Stmt::If as IN the frozen 2.2.1 subset and AC-4 grounding it verified:1.

Fix (single file thermite-tv/src/exec_stmt_encode.rs): extended the Stmt::If arm to thread an if-STATEMENT as the REQ-2 state-transformer. Each branch's stmts thread into a COPY of the current env (a NEW thread_branch helper, recursive so nested if-statements compose and an out-of-subset branch construct propagates its honest Err; absent else == identity). For each in-scope cell either branch mutated, the post-if value becomes the Verus if-EXPRESSION if <cond> { <then-cell> } else { <else-cell> } composing the two branch states (a cell mutated in neither branch is left untouched; a branch-local let does not leak). encode_value now substitutes the env FIRST so a tail naming an if-composed cell dispatches on the composed Expr::If; the if-condition is stripped of one redundant enclosing paren; an identity (bounded) arm is coerced as int to type-unify with an arithmetic (int) arm (no-else case).

Verified vs real verus 0.2026.05.24: AC-4 faithful VERIFIES (1 verified, 0 errors); swapped-branch CAUGHT (postcondition not satisfied); no-else faithful VERIFIES; nested if VERIFIES; loop-in-branch -> honest Unsupported. divergence_ac4_if_stmt_mutation (un-ignored) PASSES; B1-B4 + teeth + pins green. cargo tree -p thermite-tv = syntax + spec only. thermite-lower untouched.

Gauntlet: build --workspace OK; test --workspace 752 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored; clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean; fmt --all --check clean.
